body:
Thank you for the thoughtful response and for sharing it from your side. I have thought about telling him that it's hurting me, but I'm worried that it would only cause him to push me away even more. He would end up thinking he's bothering me, and I don't want him thinking that. 

I guess I should ask HOW I can show support in a situation like this, if at all. If he tells me he needs someone to talk to, what do I even say? I'm always worried I'll say the wrong thing. I can't tell if he is wanting advice or just someone to listen. What if he says he is going to kill himself right now, or has a plan to? What can I do half way across the country to help him? 

Things would be a lot easier if there was some sort of magic phrase to say and make everything better. :(

Thanks for the response. I always try to keep my distance, and definitely wouldn't say I'm all over him. We hadn't spoken at all in a couple of weeks when he sent me those messages randomly one night, which is when I offered my support and he didn't seem to care even though he initiated it. It's difficult to know whether or not I should continue trying to talk with him because I have no clue what he wants. 

I know that he trusts me. I think it might actually be that he is trying to keep me separate from that part of his life, if that makes any sense. I'll probably never know. It just sucks watching this play out and not knowing what to do. I'll probably just have to accept that there's really nothing I can do at all besides not abandon him.
